mood.label: RISK-OFF
mood.summary: Surging oil prices are the single most important variable today. Escalating US-Iran conflict has pushed Brent crude over $100/bbl, fueling inflation fears and pressuring equities ahead of key inflation data later this week.

indicesNarrative: US futures indicate a gap-down open, driven by a significant spike in oil prices due to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. The Dow is showing the most weakness pre-market. This oil-induced inflation fear is the primary driver of the tape, overshadowing other factors.
technicalsNarrative: Technical data is currently unavailable. Traders should exercise caution and wait for price action to confirm direction after the open, especially given the geopolitical headline risk.
